name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities (Class IX & X)

raw.catalogue_text: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities (Class IX & X) | Provider: Scholarship Division | Academic Year: 2026-27 | Type: Minority Communities | Open: 2026-06-01 | Close: 2026-10-31
raw.specification_text:
Scheme Name: Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities (Class IX & X)
Ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
Department: Scholarship Division
Target Classes: Class 9, Class 10
Academic Requirement: Secured not less than 50% marks or equivalent grade in previous final examination.
School Type Requirement: Government or private recognized secondary schools.
Annual Income Ceiling: Rs. 100000
Selection Mode: Direct / Merit
Financial Assistance: Tuition fee up to ₹4,000/year (or actual) plus maintenance allowance (₹500/month for hostellers, ₹100/month for day scholars). - Rs. 4000 per annum
Registration Requirement: One Time Registration (OTR) with Aadhaar/EID on NSP
raw.faq_text:
Q: Who can apply for Pre-Matric Scholarship Scheme for Minorities (Class IX & X)?
A: Eligible students studying in Class 9, Class 10.
Q: What is the official portal?
A: https://scholarships.gov.in
Q: Is OTR required for AY 2026-27?
A: Yes, One Time Registration is mandatory on National Scholarship Portal.
